messages:
Alex: Customer says they must use customer-managed keys (HSM-backed) for hosted API. Monthly rotation, key import, FIPS attestation required. POC scheduled next week — who can own the integration and checklist?
Priya: I can run the POC. Need a pricing approach for BYOK + HSM. Do we do a flat security add-on or usage uplift? Also need answers for their sec questionnaire ASAP.
Dan: Technically feasible. We support envelope encryption + using external KMS (AWS KMS with CloudHSM, Thales via KMIP, etc.). CloudHSM is FIPS 140-2 L3. For BYOK we either reference customer KMS keys or import wrapped keys depending on vendor.
Sarah: Customer also asked about a dedicated networking option (VPC peering) and per-request latency guarantees. Sales needs a ballpark uplift to include on the quote.
Jen: POC runbook (short):
1) Customer creates key in their KMS / HSM and grants Redwood a key usage policy.
2) We configure a key alias in Redwood pointing to kms://arn:... or kmip://host:port.
3) Run workload: 100 req/s for 30 min, capture latency and error rates.
4) Test rotation: schedule new key version, validate smooth promotion.
Example CLI (dev):
```
redwood-cli keys add --kms-uri "kms://arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/abcd" \
  --alias "cust-abc" \
  --policy-file policy.json
```
Priya: For pricing, suggest: Hosted BYOK = security add-on $500/mo + $0.02 per 10k key ops; Dedicated/Private include in reserved capacity with a one-time setup fee. Does that align with finance? @finance FYI.
Dan: Rotation notes: we support rotation via KMS schedule or via our API: POST /v1/keys/{alias}/rotate. We never export plaintext master keys; data keys are ephemeral and cached in runtime KV for performance (cache TTL configurable). All key ops are logged to audit trail which can be forwarded to customer's SIEM (CloudTrail / syslog).
Alex: Customer wants proof of HSM tamper logs and attestation. We can accept vendor attestation reports or perform remote attestation where supported. Add this as a blocker until we get vendor attestation doc.
Jen: Also callout: KMS call latency impacts tail latency. Recommend we measure RTT to customer's KMS endpoint — target <50ms for SLOs we promised. For POC we'll include a synthetic RTT test.
InfraBot: POC infra created: redwood-byo-poc-1781245678 (staging-49). Artifacts: https://internal.redwood/infra/1781245678. Logs and perf dashboards will be accessible to the customer sample account.
Dan: Questionnaire quick answers (draft):
- Key custody: customer retains root key material in their KMS; Redwood uses envelope encryption and never exports master keys.
- Key rotation: supported via customer KMS schedule or Redwood API; automated promotion of new versions supported.
- HSM attestation: accept vendor FIPS attestation or provide remote attestation output where available.
- Auditability: all key ops logged and exportable to customer SIEM.
Priya: Next steps: I will produce an initial quote with the security add-on and one-time setup fee by EOD.
Sarah: Customer call set for Tue 09:00 PT. Agenda: confirm attestation docs, pricing, and POC schedule.
Alex: Also need legal to sign BYOK/KMS addendum. @legal — please review and tell us required clauses.
Jen: I'll post the POC runbook + test scripts in the thread after lunch. :thumbsup:
Priya: Thanks — I'll consolidate and send calendar invite to the customer and cc security review.
Sarah: :thumbsup:
